video_summary: This introductory video defines neuroscience as the multidisciplinary science studying how the brain and nervous system work. It outlines the role of neuroscientists in understanding nervous system disorders and details the main subfields of neuroscience: developmental, molecular, cellular, systems, behavioural, and cognitive neuroscience.

visuals.description: Title slide introducing the topic over an illustration of interconnected neurons with glowing synaptic terminals.
A thought bubble mind map displaying various questions about brain function surrounding the central label NEUROSCIENCE.
visuals.visible_text: HOW DOES MY BRAIN WORK? How am I able to learn new things? How am I able to see? How am I able to feel? How can I remember and forget things? NEUROSCIENCE

Cognitive Neuroscience - Neural mechanisms of mental processes
